data.description: An outdoor pier area shrouded in fog, featuring a mooring bollard, a green locker marked NORTH, a gangway, and a boathouse nearby. The pier connects to a ticket office path and serves as a departure point for ferries and clinic launches.
data.name: Ferry Pier
data.narrative_significance: The Ferry Pier serves as a clandestine exchange location where Lena retrieves a cash box containing a mysterious photograph of two children beside a ferry and a storage receipt. The pier is central to the plot's mystery, involving hidden envelopes, keys, and the revelation of a photograph that may connect to Tom's father. The location represents a threshold between concealment and revelation, with fog symbolizing obscured truth.
